motifs.subject: Motif Cedar
motifs.target: SUPPORTED iff candidate_gene(C,G), gene_pathway(G,P), candidate_phenotype(C,H), and phenotype_pathway(H,P); otherwise UNKNOWN.

motifs.subject: Motif Cedar
motifs.target: Use only records matching every requested context field. Return UP, DOWN, BOTH, or UNKNOWN from their recorded directions.

motifs.subject: Motif Quartz
motifs.target: Compose directed regulation signs within the requested context. Multiply signs along paths; return UP, DOWN, BOTH, or UNKNOWN.

motifs.subject: Motif Quartz
motifs.target: Count distinct primary_source IDs for each sign. Two sources support a sign. Return SUPPORTED, REFUTED, BOTH, or UNKNOWN.

motifs.subject: Motif Vela
motifs.target: Match the claim and every context field. POS or UP supports, NEG or DOWN refutes. Return SUPPORTED, REFUTED, BOTH, or UNKNOWN; never resolve a conflict by majority vote.

motifs.subject: Motif Vela
motifs.target: Choose which proposed missing edge completes the candidate_gene/gene_pathway/candidate_phenotype/phenotype_pathway join. Return A, B, MULTIPLE, or NONE.
